Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/fill-worker.ts:31

Merged fill result — flat interleaved buffers the caller writes into geometry attributes (pos xyz triplets, col rgb triplets). Chunks that compact variable-length output (belt rejection sampling, the deep-field sentinel drop) return kept — the merged buffers are sliced to the true point count by the caller via count.
